mechanism: Atazanavir requires acidic gastric pH for optimal absorption, while amoxicillin clavulanate may cause GI upset and potentially affect absorption, plus both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism with potential for altered pharmacokinetics.
action: Monitor atazanavir efficacy and viral load; consider timing doses 2 hours apart and assess for adequate atazanavir levels; maintain adequate hydration and monitor for GI side effects.
